text:
devon_support: FYI — Acme flagged a sudden drop in rerank quality for their search assistant after last week's model refresh. They see lots of irrelevant top results.

maria_cs: Copy of customer note: 'Since the model change on 3/12 our most common queries return worse recommendations; precision@5 down ~20% vs last week. This is urgent for our support use case.'

acme_infra: Adding sample query and expected vs actual (redacted):
- query: 'reset password flow for enterprise users'
- expected top: article A, B, C
- actual top: unrelated KB D, generic onboarding E
- metric screenshot: similarity scores dropped from ~0.78 to 0.52 for gold docs

devon_support: Repro steps from Acme: call /v1/embeddings with model=embed-2024-large -> index -> rerank with top-k 50 -> scoring by cosine -> top results inconsistent. They included payload snippet:```json
{ "model": "embed-2024-large", "input": "reset password flow for enterprise users" }
```

jon_sales: Acme is on a committed Dedicated plan. They're worried about SLA impact and will escalate to their ops lead if not handled this week.

lee_prod: @tara_engml @maria_cs can we get a quick triage? Need to decide if this is a product bug (regression), model drift, or customer config mismatch. Also need launch/rollback options if we ship fixes.

tara_engml: initial hypothesis: the new embed-2024-large variant changed normalization/scale and the reranker scoring pipeline didn't rescale similarities. Two likely mitigations: 1) rescale/re-normalize embeddings at ingestion time, 2) add a per-customer similarity threshold tuning API.

tara_engml: quick check idea: compute cosine distributions for same queries on previous model vs new model. If mean/variance shifted that explains drop.

maria_cs: Customer provided 100 sample queries + ground truth doc ids. I'll attach them to the ticket.

opsbot: New ticket created: CS-1248 "Acme: rerank precision drop after embed model update" assigned to eng-ml and product.

lee_prod: OK. Product asks: - reproduce with Acme dataset - define acceptance criteria for a fix - estimate effort - recommend rollout strategy and fallback.

jon_sales: Add commercial constraints: they want no customer-visible regression during fix; prefer canary + opt-in toggle so they can validate before full switch.

tara_engml: Possible solutions (fast -> slow):
- quick: runtime rescaling factor applied to cosine scores per-model (low risk).
- medium: expose per-customer threshold and top-k blending param.
- longer: training/finetune reranker on Acme labeled set or add an adaptive calibrator.

lee_prod: We need success metrics. Propose: restore precision@5 to within 5% of pre-change baseline on Acme's sample set; overall latency increase <= 50ms P95; canary to 10% without errors for 48h.

maria_cs: I'll collect the 100-sample labeled set, recent logs, and the call traces. Expect to upload by EOD Thurs.

tara_engml: I can run distribution diffs and a quick rescale experiment by Friday. If rescale works, we can push a config change as a hotfix.

lee_prod: If rescale isn't sufficient, we draft an RFC for per-customer tuning endpoint + monitoring. Estimate: implementation + QA ~ 2 sprints for medium solution, 4+ sprints for longer retrain path.

jon_sales: Noted. We'll tell Acme the triage plan and timeline: potential hotfix in days, full solution in sprints. Keep me in the loop for customer comms.

maria_cs: Communicating now: I'll tell them devs are triaging, sharing sample set, and we aim for a quick config hotfix first.

devon_support: Logging note: CS-1248 severity = high; impact = search relevance for support flows; customer may require rollback of model update if unresolved.

tara_engml: Questions for product: do we want a per-customer baseline evaluation job that runs after any embed model rollout? That would catch regressions before customer impact.

lee_prod: Good idea. Add to RFC: preflight evaluation harness + blocking metric checks for embed model switches (precision thresholds per-customer). That increases rollout friction but improves reliability.

opsbot: Status change: CS-1248 moved to product-backlog by lee_prod.

acme_infra: Thanks — we'll send the labeled set and some raw request logs to the S3 path you shared. Please keep the option to revert the new embed model on our index.

maria_cs: Confirmed. Revert flag enabled for Acme index; will hold until we complete canary.

lee_prod: Action items: 1) tara run distro + quick rescale experiment by Fri (assigned). 2) maria upload labeled set and logs by Thu EOD. 3) lee to open RFC if rescale fails (will include preflight harness, per-customer threshold API, canary rollout plan). 4) jon handle customer comms.

devon_support: Thanks team. I'll keep monitoring CS-1248 and update thread with any new Acme feedback.

maria_cs: :thumbsup:

jon_sales: :eyes:

lee_prod: :pray:
